findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?ref=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taifoon_demand, taifoon_grid, taifoon_sell, taifoon_op · Private data: taifoon_account, taifoon_find, taifoon_vault, taifoon_orderbook, taifoon_grid · Public sink: taifoon_find, taifoon_demand, taifoon_hire, taifoon_grid, taifoon_sell, taifoon_op · Destructive: taifoon_find.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taifoon_demand, taifoon_grid, taifoon_sell, taifoon_op · Private data: taifoon_account, taifoon_find, taifoon_vault, taifoon_orderbook, taifoon_grid · Public sink: taifoon_find, taifoon_demand, taifoon_hire, taifoon_grid, taifoon_sell, taifoon_op · Destructive: taifoon_find

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
